rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are capped at the lower of 3% or 80% of the 12-month CPI change; no increase is allowed if CPI is negative. Landlords must give written notice of the ordinance and tenant rights at lease start or with any rent increase notice.
rules.key_value: lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change per year
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period.
rules.effective_date_note: Page states the ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021. The ordinance adoption date is not given (a Tuesday before the page date).
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990. Owners may petition the City Manager for relief if a higher increase is needed for a fair and reasonable return.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental buildings constructed on or before February 1, 1995.
rules.interaction: Local cap; the allowable increase is published annually by June 30 and effective September 1.

unverifiable_exemptions: mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, an owner cannot end a tenancy without a just cause stated in a written notice. For at-fault causes the owner must first give notice and a chance to cure. For no-fault terminations the owner must give 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the final 3 months of rent.
rules.key_value: just cause required after 30 days; 3 months relocation assistance or rent waiver for no-fault
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.effective_date_note: Page states the ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021. Notice to existing tenants was due before December 19, 2021.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; other shared living quarters.
rules.coverage_conditions: Private residential rentals not within the listed exemptions.
rules.interaction: Local ordinance; governs in Santa Ana in place of the state just-cause law where both apply.

unverifiable_exemptions: dormitories and other shared living quarters

parsed.doc_summary: Santa Ana city press release on the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (3% / 80% CPI cap, buildings built after 2/1/1995 exempt) and the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (relocation assistance, 15-year new-construction exemption), both effective Nov. 19, 2021.
